explanation: The value sits at about 10 at every step while the agent is choosing a2, and at GO it is always 9-10. While the agent is choosing a1 it drops at D2 (about 5-7 early in the episode, 0-4 late in the episode, and 0-2 on a trial right after an unrewarded one), and D1 stays around 8-9 unless the previous trial was unrewarded, when it falls to about 0-5.
